title: Try beekeeping before you buy a single thing: start with a taster day
alt: Two white wooden beehives stand in rough grass among bare young trees beside a wire fence.

posts.facebook:
Ever wondered what goes on inside a beehive?

A honey bee colony changes through the year, from spring swarming, when part of the colony leaves to find a new home, to living on its food stores through winter. Learning to read those signs is a big part of the craft.

Your local beekeeping association runs taster days and beginners' courses, and can often pair you with a mentor. That way you handle bees before you buy a single thing.

Would you like to see inside a hive?
